pullRequests.title: fix(port): draw Hoven ice beneath its scuff decals
pullRequests.author: pezzadev
pullRequests.head: hoven-ice-scuffs
pullRequests.body:
Both ice layers on Hoven belong before the shrub pass. The translucent layer previously drew in the late effects pass and washed out the scuff decals. Mark the start of the RAC1 shrub pass so the earlier strips use the existing early effects pass.
Verification

Reproduced the washout and confirmed the restored scuffs in live RAC1 NTSC-U gameplay on Windows with Vulkan. Compared the captured draw list and the same in-game view.
Built openrac-rac1-ntsc from the local disc on Windows after…

pullRequests.title: feat(sdk): require native mods to opt in to Vulkan access
pullRequests.author: pezzadev
pullRequests.head: sdk-vulkan-opt-in
pullRequests.body:
What changed

Native mods targeting API 1.20 declare "vulkan_queue": true to use OpenRAC's Vulkan handles, device setup, or native view images. Loading an opted-in mod keeps Vulkan rendering and queue submission on the game thread for the session. Mods targeting older APIs retain their existing behavior.
The launcher and SDK packager validate the declaration. GitHub previews check the declared API version, and the installer checks the compiled library listed in the release ZIP.
The starter…

pullRequests.title: fix(launcher): short Secret Agent Clank name, keep the subtitle whole
pullRequests.author: nickyyOO
pullRequests.head: fix/launcher-subtitles
pullRequests.body:
Before: the launcher showed "Ratchet & Clank: Secret Agent Clank". On the desktop game page a long title could break inside the game's own name ("Going" / "Commando").
After: the launcher shows "Secret Agent Clank". On the desktop game page the game's own name moves to its own line, whole, when the title does not fit on one line.
How: withShownTitles in labels.ts maps the shown name when the library is read. The game page splits the title with titleLines into two inline blocks; a two-part title…

pullRequests.title: fix(launcher): keep an installed mod the index has no archive of for this platform
pullRequests.author: Promises
pullRequests.head: launcher-keep-installed-without-platform
pullRequests.body:
What
An installed native mod whose index entry has no archive for this platform (a hand-built copy, say) no longer holds back every other mod's update. Its installed version now fits as it is. Game, disc, API and revocation still count. A mod that is not installed still has nothing to install here (NotForPlatform, as before).
This is the follow-up I offered in the notes of #554.
Why

Glawks' Weapon Wheel Pause publishes a Windows build only. On Linux I built it from its release with its own CI…

pullRequests.title: fix(rac2): Sheepinator no longer deletes Joba arena robots (T-45)
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: fix/rac2-sheepinator-arena
pullRequests.body:
The Sheepinator turned a just-recycled Joba arena security robot again, deleting it; with all 16 gone the Impossible Challenge round never ended (USA v1.01 only, also on PS2; PAL and v2.00 already keep it).
Fixed for v1.01, shown as an always-on Game fix in the launcher (new kind "always"), with the Mapper markers moved there too.

pullRequests.title: fix(rac2): keep the Field of View while the weapon wheel is open (T-49)
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: fix/rac2-fov-weapon-wheel
pullRequests.body:
Opening the weapon wheel puts the game in mode 4, and the custom Field of View only applied in mode 0, so the view zoomed back to default.
The rac2 profile now names mode 4 as the quick select, which keeps the gameplay lens.

pullRequests.title: feat(launcher): copy saves from the game's other disc
pullRequests.author: farfeduc
pullRequests.head: feat/save-copy-discs
pullRequests.body:
The problem
Each disc has its own memory card (memcard/<serial>/). Build Ratchet & Clank from the PAL disc, play, then rebuild from the US disc: the PAL saves seem gone. They are still on the PAL card, which the US game never reads. This was asked for in the Discord's feature-requests ("Save compatible between version").
The saves themselves are compatible:

every Ratchet & Clank disc (PAL v2.00 and v1.00, US, Japan) lists the same chunks with the same ids and sizes (save_edit.rs);

pullRequests.title: feat(sdk): a hook point called as the game calls it, interface 1.21
pullRequests.author: farfeduc
pullRequests.head: feat/hook-entry
pullRequests.body:
A mod that does what the game does at a hook point sometimes wants the other mods' hooks there to apply. A mod's own weapon takes its rounds as the game's weapons do, and another mod's infinite ammo should cover it too. Until now the only way was function() with the game function's name in one disc's build (FUN_L00_00233db8 on NTSC-U for rac1.weapon.take_ammo). That is another name on each disc, and nothing says that the function it returns goes through the hook chain.
Interface 1.21 adds one…
